summary: One-paragraph account of the audit: what the source claimed, which capabilities were judged better, and what was dismissed and why.

provenance.description: Object identifying the audited bookmark. Always { source_type, bookmark_id, source_url }; source_type "article" needs nothing more, source_type "github" also needs local_clone (a workspace-relative path below inspiration/raindrop/) and source_commit (the full 40-char lowercase hex commit of the clone). Validation resolves the clone and the commit from the worker working directory.

source_url.description: The http(s) URL of the source, without embedded credentials.
The http(s) URL of the source, without embedded credentials.

local_clone.description: The workspace-relative clone path below inspiration/raindrop/.

source_commit.description: The full 40-character lowercase hex commit of the clone.

plan_artifacts.description: Array of { path, disposition, summary } for the research and plan artifacts this audit wrote. path is relative to the worker working directory and names a docs/research/*.md or docs/plans/*.md file that must exist; disposition is "created" or "updated". Exactly one docs/research/*.md research artifact is required; a plan belongs here only when the audit reached a proposal. The companion docs/plans/README.md roster edit is not an artifact entry.

path.description: The workspace-relative path of the artifact.

disposition.description: Whether the audit created or updated the artifact.

definition_proposals.description: Array of definition-improvement proposals. Empty when the source justifies no definition change.

title.description: Concise title describing the definition gap and the proposed change. Slugified into the docs/improvements filename.

target_kind.description: What kind of definition the proposal targets: one of step_prompt, workflow_template, handoff_schema, review_rubric, validator, test, project_instruction, adr.

target_path.description: Workspace-relative path of the definition the proposal is about (e.g. src/agent-skills/systematic-debugging/SKILL.md). Never mutated; the consumer writes a separate proposal doc.

authority.description: Which definition layer owns the target: project_local (this repo), user_global (~/.flywheel), or shipped_default (the bundled definitions). The consumer derives the risk tier from this; do not self-assess risk.

source_evidence.description: Array of { kind, reference, summary }. kind is one of step_failure, handoff_validation_failure, retry_pattern, review_finding, qa_gap, user_correction, budget_exhaustion, verification_gap, trace_fact, external_source; reference names a durable artifact (fact position, session id, handoff field, file:line); summary is one sentence.

reference.description: A durable artifact: a fact position, a session id, a handoff field, or file:line.

finding.description: What went wrong or what friction recurred, grounded in the cited evidence.

proposal.description: The specific definition change proposed and why it prevents recurrence.

diff_preview.description: A unified-diff sketch of the proposed change. Evidence only; the deterministic consumer never applies it.

acceptance_check.description: How a reviewer verifies the change worked (a command, a scenario, an observable behavior).
